target_customer: Companies and AI product builders who need agents to produce on-brand output
problem: Agents and AI tools lack structured, current brand context, so generated content drifts from the brand.
business_model: B2B SaaS with MCP and REST API access
product_category: Brand context infrastructure for AI agents

founders.name: Ray Fitzgerald
previous_startups: Lucid, an AI-native word processor (outcome not researched)
founders.background_notes: Education not listed on the YC page.

competitors.name: AirOps Brand Kit
competitors.what: Brand kits connected to Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT via MCP

competitors.name: Brandkit
competitors.what: Brand assets accessible to AI assistants via MCP

competitors.name: Frontify
competitors.what: Brand portal with an MCP server announced May 2026

technical_complexity.rationale: Extracting, versioning and serving brand context through MCP and API is standard engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Many brand tools ship MCP servers and the wedge is copyable; lock-in would come from stored versioned brand data.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents were already shipping MCP brand access in spring 2026.

market_need_then: Founder's earlier launch as Bloom reportedly drew 15K signups in December 2025 per its YC page as relayed by search; no paying demand data found.

branding.name_origin: Renamed from Bloom on 15 October 2026 because the new name makes the brand layer for agents focus clearer, per Dealroom news.
branding.domain_note: Moved from trybloom.ai to rainbrand.com in October 2026

rebrands.why: Clearer focus on being the brand layer for agents

branding.community_and_virality: Launch as Bloom reportedly went viral with 15K signups, per YC page via search summary

brand_strength.rationale: Descriptive new name after a rebrand a month ago; the earlier Bloom launch had viral reach but the new brand has no track record.

outcome_analysis: Rainbrand, formerly Bloom, is a Spring 2026 YC company with no outcome yet. It reports early viral signups and a roughly one million dollar pre-seed, but several brand tools already ship MCP access, so differentiation and monetization are the open questions.
notes: The 1M pre-seed (500K Nebular led with Guillermo Rauch, 500K YC) appears in Dealroom news and the YC jobs listing for Bloom, seen via search snippets; Dealroom's table separately shows a 125k seed and Neuronfeed 500K. Round date is only known as 2026. Frontify date from a vendor ranking page.
